sources.author: Heval
patch_list: Makes Google sign-in and Google services work. Requires MicroG RE.
Fixes Google features that check the app's original signature.

sources.label: Vibe
sources.author: Vibe
patch_list: Hides the 'This app is out of date' update screen, new version popup, and Google Play services update prompt.
Changes the version code of 365Score to prevent forced updates.
Disables Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) initialization and the app's own ad placements, removing banner, interstitial, rewarded, native and mediated ads.
Removes analytics and tracking (Firebase Analytics) from 365Score.
Makes Google sign-in and Google APIs work by routing them to MicroG RE instead of Google Play services. Requires MicroG RE (app.revanced.android.gms) and a Google account added in it.
Makes the app report its original signing certificate to itself, so Firebase and Google APIs restricted to the original app keep working.
Unlocks 365Score premium/pro features (ad-free, tipster, plus, notification sounds).
